title: John C NDE 313
content: I was having a 'simple knee surgery.' I was in recovery when I opened my eyes and remember I was not breathing. Next my doctor was leaning over me and yelling, 'Breathe, damn it, breathe!' I could not and started to lose consciousness, and then instantaneously I blacked out. Then I began to rise above my body. I was very much aware of what was going on. I had my back to the light and I felt such peace. I heard them call the code blue I watched as they tried to resuscitate me. I remember, I can't describe it well, I guess like I was in a fourth dimension. I could see my hands and feet everything was so perfect. Then I heard a voice, but not audible, and said, 'It is not your time yet my son. You must go back. I have things for you to do.' My feelings were I wanted to stay. Then like zap, I was like sucked back into my body and awoke as the doctor pounded on my chest. Pure Love. I had an OBE in July of this year twice but was not exactly the same.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Surgery-related Clinical death Sometime later my doctor said I had heart and respiratory failure.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Life review | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It came from behind me.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe My spiritual path, I became an ordained minister and laid hands on many people and they were healed, some not though. More were healed.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I begged to go to the light and I was told not yet I had things to do.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I begged to go to the light and I was told not yet I had things to do. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What is your religion now?: Liberal I do not have a religion at this time
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I am not afraid to die. I became more spiritual and had a quest for knowledge.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes The healing and seem to draw people to God and just seem to know things.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: A few years ago, when my father passed to the other side as I call it, I met two individuals like angels in bodies and they told me it happened to them and I was to continue on my path of telling others.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I was told to tell others that God exists.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes The two OBEs in July of this year.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Not at this time except I am positive God exists.
